entities.title: The match ends when the host leaves
entities.summary: Only the host's browser knows where the intel and traps are, so a match can't go on without it.
entities.impact: Everyone else is told the host left and goes back to the briefing room, where the next lowest slot hosts.

entities.title: No touch controls
entities.summary: The game is played with a keyboard and mouse, or a gamepad; phones and tablets can load it but not play it.
entities.impact: Players on phones can only watch the menus.

entities.title: No sound
entities.summary: The game has no audio yet.
entities.impact: Traps going off are only seen.

entities.title: No joining a match in progress
entities.summary: Someone who joins the relay during a match waits in the briefing room for the next one.
entities.impact: A late friend watches nothing until the match ends.
